name: Tiptoe
source:
Tiptoe is one of the employees at the Ghoul's Grove who works at the cafeteria. They are of aboriginal descent and has a centaur-like body with a saddlebag and quilts covering most of their lower half. Scars are seen all over their body including the hands, neck and face. 

They have a tired appearance and personality, but despite sleeping on the job, they seem to take their job very seriously. 

In the casting call for Tiptoe's character, they are listed as nonbinary, but within the game, Darcy refers to Tiptoe with he/him pronouns as he is unaware.
